_comment: Human-reviewed licence facts for scripts/license-audit.py. Regenerate the derivable parts with --write; the `images` and `exceptions` maps are hand-maintained and require review.

@fontsource-variable/manrope.posture: Font binaries shipped in the SPA bundle.

@fontsource/ibm-plex-mono.posture: Font binaries shipped in the SPA bundle.

@fontsource/inter.obligation: OFL-1.1 text + copyright notice must accompany the fonts; the fonts must not be sold on their own and Reserved Font Names must not be reused
@fontsource/inter.posture: Font binaries shipped in the SPA bundle.

@fontsource/space-grotesk.posture: Font binaries shipped in the SPA bundle.

arista-mibs.obligation: no stated grant; industry practice treats vendor MIBs as freely redistributable for interop, but that is practice, not licence
arista-mibs.owner_decision: REQUIRED — either fetch them at build time like the other ~55 vendor MIBs already are (the gen_index.py pattern, which leaves nothing in the tree), or obtain and record Arista's redistribution position
arista-mibs.posture: Two Arista enterprise MIB modules ship inside the customer source tarball, sourced from the LibreNMS mirror.

balabit/syslog-ng.obligation: ship the GPL-2.0 + LGPL-2.1 texts and a written offer for syslog-ng's Corresponding Source
balabit/syslog-ng.owner_decision: REQUIRED — confirm we can honour a source request for syslog-ng 4.7.1 OSE (mirror the upstream tarball with the release), and note there is NO OpenSSL linking exception
balabit/syslog-ng.posture: Core archive, unmodified upstream container. Receives syslog over the network and writes to Kafka; no Correlix code is linked into it, and it links to none of ours. GPL-2.0-or-later applies to the syslog-ng combination only.

busybox.obligation: source availability for the unmodified BusyBox in redistributed base images
busybox.owner_decision: REQUIRED — decide whether to mirror base-image sources or rely on the upstream registries
busybox.posture: Present only as a local dev helper image and inside Alpine/BusyBox bases of third-party images we redistribute unmodified.

certifi.obligation: licence text + upstream source pointer in the shipped notices
certifi.posture: Installed unmodified into site-packages in netops-correlation. MPL-2.0 file-level copyleft; we modify nothing, so only the notice + source-availability pointer applies.

cisco-mib-extracts.obligation: none we can satisfy from the file itself — there is no grant to comply with
cisco-mib-extracts.owner_decision: REQUIRED — replace SNMPv2-TC / SNMPv2-CONF with the canonical IETF RFC 1903/1904 module text (removes the ambiguity outright), or accept the risk in writing
cisco-mib-extracts.posture: Two Cisco-headered extracts of RFC 1903/1904 ship inside the customer SOURCE TARBALL. They are build-time inputs to the OID index; no MIB prose reaches the shipped binary (oididx.json is bare OID->name facts).

cloud-vendor-marks.obligation: trademark terms of use, not a copyright licence; the AWS asset is the AWS Cloud LOGO, which is additionally governed by AWS trademark guidelines rather than the Architecture Icons ToU alone
cloud-vendor-marks.owner_decision: REQUIRED — confirm logo (not service-icon) use is intended and permitted, and move the terms from the asset READMEs into NOTICE so they travel with the binary
cloud-vendor-marks.posture: AWS/Azure/GCP marks go:embed'd into the shipped backend binary and rendered in RCA reports. Asset READMEs already record the source package, the terms URL and the render-as-is rule.

connector-marks.obligation: none while unused, but they still ship in the source tarball
connector-marks.owner_decision: REQUIRED — delete both files (nothing references them), or document their terms if a connector UI is planned
connector-marks.posture: Unreferenced Jira and ServiceNow marks sitting in the frontend source tree with no terms recorded.

elkjs.obligation: licence text + written source offer (upstream URL) in the shipped notices
elkjs.owner_decision: none needed — permissive-compatible for our use
elkjs.posture: BUNDLED VERBATIM into the SPA (dist/assets/elk.bundled-*.js). EPL-2.0 is file-level copyleft: we do not modify elkjs, so no source-disclosure of OUR code is triggered. EPL-2.0 §3.2 DOES require that recipients of the Object Code be told the licence and how to obtain Source. Vite strips the banner, so the notice MUST be carried by THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md shipped with the frontend image.

gotenberg/gotenberg.owner_decision: REQUIRED — keep the `pdf` profile permanently out of customer bundles, or switch to a slim Gotenberg variant without msttcorefonts/PDFtk before ever shipping it
gotenberg/gotenberg.posture: Gotenberg's own code is MIT, but the image bundles PDFtk (GPL-2.0-or-later), LibreOffice (MPL-2.0), ttf-mscorefonts-installer (PROPRIETARY Microsoft EULA restricting redistribution) and, on amd64, Google Chrome (proprietary). It is NOT in any bundle today (the `pdf` profile is excluded from BASE_PROFILES), so no obligation is currently carried.

grafana/grafana.obligation: ship the AGPL-3.0 text + a written offer for Grafana's Corresponding Source (upstream URL); state prominently that Grafana is unmodified
grafana/grafana.owner_decision: REQUIRED — confirm the add-on-pack posture, or drop Grafana from the customer bundle entirely
grafana/grafana.posture: Ships ONLY in the optional `self-monitoring` add-on pack, as an unmodified upstream container, reached on its own port/route. No Correlix code links to, embeds, or derives from Grafana; we do not modify it, so AGPL §13 imposes no obligation to offer OUR source.

quay.io/keycloak/keycloak.obligation: Red Hat UBI EULA terms on redistribution (permitted, with conditions)
quay.io/keycloak/keycloak.owner_decision: REQUIRED — review the UBI EULA redistribution conditions for an on-prem appliance bundle, or rebase Keycloak onto a non-UBI image
quay.io/keycloak/keycloak.posture: Keycloak itself is Apache-2.0, but its base is Red Hat ubi9-micro, governed by the Red Hat Universal Base Image EULA rather than an OSS licence. The `sso` profile IS in BASE_PROFILES, so this image ships in the core bundle.

require-like.owner_decision: none needed while it stays build-only
require-like.posture: Transitive build-only dependency of the Docusaurus dev toolchain (docs-portal). Never distributed — only the BUILT static HTML ships. No licence grant is needed to run a build tool we do not redistribute.

timberio/vector.posture: Separate container, unmodified upstream image. Our vector.yaml/VRL are configuration under MPL §1.10/§3.3 Larger Work, not modifications.

alpine.note: Alpine base distro packages are mostly MIT/BSD; busybox and apk-tools are GPL-2.0-only, shipped unmodified.

apache/kafka.note: Alpine/Temurin-21 base. LICENSE-binary adds EPL-2.0, EDL-1.0, CDDL-1.1 and GPL-2.0-with-Classpath-exception (Jakarta/Jersey) plus the JRE; all separate-process, unmodified.

balabit/syslog-ng.note: syslog-ng OSE 4.7.1 split licence: core (lib/, syslog-ng/, syslog-ng-ctl/) LGPL-2.1-or-later; modules/ and scl/ GPL-2.0-or-later. The stock image loads all modules, so the running combination is effectively GPL-2.0-or-later. NO OpenSSL linking exception exists. Run unmodified, separate process, no linking to our code.

busybox.note: BusyBox is GPL-2.0-only (not or-later). Unmodified, separate container.
busybox.unit: NOT SHIPPED — local dev helper only

curlimages/curl.note: SPDX id is literally `curl` (MIT/X11 derivative), NOT MIT. Alpine base.
curlimages/curl.unit: compose bundle — core archive (one-shot init job)

debian.note: Placeholder: the base is a Debian rootfs (mixed licences, incl. GPL utilities). swtpm/libtpms are BSD-3-Clause. Not in any customer bundle.

gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12.note: distroless tooling Apache-2.0; contents are ca-certificates, tzdata, passwd from Debian.

golang.note: Go toolchain; build stage only, not in the final distroless image.

gotenberg/gotenberg.note: FLAG: Gotenberg's own Go code is MIT, but the debian:12-slim image bundles PDFtk (GPL-2.0-or-later), LibreOffice (MPL-2.0), ttf-mscorefonts-installer (PROPRIETARY Microsoft EULA with redistribution restrictions) and, on amd64, Google Chrome (proprietary). Must not enter a customer bundle without owner sign-off. The `:8` tag is a floating major tag.
gotenberg/gotenberg.unit: NOT SHIPPED — optional `pdf` profile, excluded from every bundle

grafana/grafana.note: AGPL-3.0-only per upstream package.json + LICENSING.md (relicensed from Apache-2.0 at v9.0). Shipped UNMODIFIED as a separate container; no Correlix code links to or derives from it. AGPL §13 network clause applies to Grafana's own UI, which we neither modify nor proxy-rebrand.

netboxcommunity/netbox.note: App (netbox) and image build (netbox-docker) both Apache-2.0. Ubuntu 24.04 base; its transitive Python/Django tree is UNAUDITED because the image never ships.
netboxcommunity/netbox.unit: NOT SHIPPED — optional `netbox` profile, excluded from every bundle

nginx.note: Base image for our own frontend/nginx images. Alpine base.

node.unit: frontend build stage (Dockerfile.frontend.full, unused by default)

opensearchproject/opensearch.note: Apache-2.0, NOT SSPL/Elastic. Bundles an Adoptium JDK (GPL-2.0-only WITH Classpath-exception-2.0). We MODIFY it (plugin strip in deployment/docker/opensearch/Dockerfile) -> Apache-2.0 §4 duty to carry prominent notice of changes.
opensearchproject/opensearch.unit: compose bundle — core archive (rebuilt as netops-opensearch)

python.note: CPython under PSF-2.0 on a debian:12-slim rootfs; the Debian userland carries GPL-2.0/GPL-3.0 utilities, unmodified, source available from Debian.

quay.io/keycloak/keycloak.note: FLAG: Keycloak is Apache-2.0, but the image base is Red Hat ubi9-micro, governed by the Red Hat UBI EULA (not an OSS licence). Redistribution is permitted under the UBI terms but needs its own review line.
quay.io/keycloak/keycloak.unit: compose bundle — core archive (`sso` profile is in BASE_PROFILES)

telegraf.note: MIT (unchanged at 1.31). Its Go dependency tree carries MPL-2.0 (HashiCorp) and EPL-2.0 (Eclipse Paho); irrelevant while the image does not ship.
telegraf.unit: NOT SHIPPED — `legacy` profile, excluded from every bundle

timberio/vector.note: MPL-2.0 is file-level copyleft. We run it UNMODIFIED (vector-router only layers `apk add curl` on top; no Vector source is touched) and our vector.yaml/VRL are configuration, not modifications. Obligation is notice + a pointer to upstream source only.

ubuntu.note: Placeholder for a mixed-licence Debian/Ubuntu rootfs; operator tooling only.

valkey/valkey.note: Replaced Redis (RSALv2/SSPL) — see LICENSES.md resolved history. Alpine base.

victoriametrics/victoria-metrics.note: OSS build: enterprise images carry an `-enterprise` tag suffix, which this does not.

license_texts.Written offer for Corresponding Source (:
Correlix redistributes the following components UNMODIFIED, as separate
containers or as separate files. For each, the complete corresponding source
for the exact version shipped is available from the upstream project, and
Correlix will additionally provide it on written request for three years:

  syslog-ng OSE 4.7.1   GPL-2.0-or-later / LGPL-2.1-or-later
                        https://github.com/syslog-ng/syslog-ng (tag syslog-ng-4.7.1)
  Grafana 11.2.0        AGPL-3.0-only (self-monitoring add-on pack only)
                        https://github.com/grafana/grafana (tag v11.2.0)
  Vector 0.40.0         MPL-2.0
                        https://github.com/vectordotdev/vector (tag v0.40.0)
  elkjs 0.11.1          EPL-2.0 (bundled in the web UI)
                        https://github.com/kieler/elkjs (tag v0.11.1)
  certifi 2026.5.20     MPL-2.0
                        https://github.com/certifi/python-certifi

None of these components is modified by Correlix, and no Correlix code is
linked into, derived from, or combined with them beyond running them as
separate processes configured through their own public interfaces.

arista-mibs.note: 'Copyright (c) 2008 Arista Networks, Inc. All rights reserved.' with no licence text. Vendors publish enterprise MIBs for management-tool interop, but no explicit redistribution grant accompanies the files.

cloud-vendor-marks.note: Official AWS Architecture Icons (the AWS Cloud LOGO, not a service icon), Azure Public Service Icons and the Google Cloud symbol. Governed by each vendor's trademark/icon terms of use, not by copyright licence. Terms are recorded in the asset READMEs; they are go:embed'd into the shipped backend binary, so the terms must travel with it.
cloud-vendor-marks.unit: api image (netops-api) — go:embed'd into the binary

connector-marks.note: Atlassian and ServiceNow marks with no terms documented. Grepping src/frontend/src finds zero references — they are unused files that still ship in the source tarball.
connector-marks.unit: NOT REFERENCED — dead assets in the frontend source tree

feather-icons.note: ~20 icons in Icon.tsx carry Feather's verbatim path coordinates (compass/activity/sliders/shield/lock/unlock/file-text/grid/x/arrow-*/maximize/log-out). Feather is MIT, (c) 2013-2023 Cole Bemis. MIT REQUIRES the copyright notice and permission text be retained in redistributions.

ietf-rfc-mibs.note: MIB modules are RFC Code Components; the IETF Trust Legal Provisions license them under the Simplified/Modified BSD terms, so redistribution is permitted with the notice. P-BRIDGE-MIB and Q-BRIDGE-MIB carry the Internet Society (2006) / RFC 4363 notice inline.

lucide-icons.note: check / chevron family / external-link / mail / sliders-horizontal follow Lucide's coordinates. Lucide is ISC and itself retains Feather's MIT notice. ISC requires notice retention.

natural-earth-110m.note: Natural Earth is explicitly public domain; no permission or attribution required (a credit is a courtesy). Packaging pipeline (world-atlas) is ISC.

netclaw-knowledge.note: Troubleshooting PROCEDURES mined from the NetClaw project (Apache-2.0, John Capobianco), re-expressed as this project's own command tables and deterministic parsers. No NetClaw code, runtime or LLM component is present. Already attributed in NOTICE and in the file header.
netclaw-knowledge.unit: source tarball + api image (knowledge only, no code)
